title: Venus Meaning
overview: Venus describes attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, money, comfort, desire, and the conditions that help connection feel worth choosing. It shows what someone is drawn toward and what helps affection become real rather than only appealing.
cycle: Venus moves through all twelve signs in about a year, with retrograde cycles that ask for review around love, value, beauty, money, and desire. Its sign describes the style of relating; its house shows where ease, attraction, and value become active.

signs.body: With Venus in Aries, you love passionately, thriving on challenges and the excitement of vibrant, competitive romance. You express affection with an adventurous spirit, cherishing spontaneous and enthusiastic displays of love.

With Venus in Taurus, you are all about sensuality and tangible expressions of love. You are drawn to comfort, stability, and pleasure. You value fidelity and consistency, enjoying a slow-burning romance that gradually builds over time.

With Venus in Gemini, your love life is marked by curiosity and excitement. Intellectual conversations captivate you, and a mental connection is often a prerequisite for romance. You value variety and intellectual compatibility in relationships.
With Venus in Cancer, your love is nurturing, protective, and deep. Home and family are central to your sense of comfort and security in a relationship.

With Venus in Leo, your love is dramatic, warm, and generous. You appreciate grand gestures of love and seek to be adored and admired in your relationships. You are drawn to people who are confident and expressive, and you enjoy sharing a glamorous social life with your partner.

With Venus in Virgo, your affection is shown through practical means. You value stability and show your love by taking care of the small details that contribute to your partner’s wellbeing. Your love language often involves acts of service, and you seek meaningful and productive relationships.

With Venus in Libra, you value balance, harmony, and partnership in love. You are diplomatic and fair-minded in your relationships and are drawn to beauty and charm. Your sense of romance involves a deep appreciation for cooperation and shared experiences.

With Venus in Scorpio, your love is intense, passionate, and transformative. You seek deep emotional bonds and are drawn to mysteries and the hidden depths of your partner. Your relationships are intimate, reflecting your desire for deep emotional exchange.

With Venus in Sagittarius, your love is adventurous, optimistic, and freedom-loving. You prioritize honesty, intellectual stimulation, and shared adventures in relationships. You’re drawn to open-minded individuals who can broaden your horizons and share your zest for life.
With Venus in Capricorn, your love is mature, loyal, and reserved. You value practicality and reliability, preferring to show your affection through steadfast support and shared ambitions.

With Venus in Aquarius, your love is free-spirited, intellectual, and somewhat unconventional. You value friendship and shared ideals in your relationships, and you’re attracted to those who stimulate your mind and respect your need for independence.

With Venus in Pisces, your love is compassionate, imaginative, and selfless. You value emotional connection and spiritual bonding, often showing your affection through empathetic selfless acts of kindness. You’re attracted to those who can share in your dreamy, romantic visions.

source.title: As Above, So Below: A Guide to Astrology for Tarot Readers
